# Exact bounding-box-stratified king-polyplets (refines A006770).
# B_{H,W}(n) = # polyplets, n cells, height EXACTLY H, width EXACTLY W.
# CRT over 3 primes near 2^31 (exact for n<=~32). H<=14 swept; H>14 via
# transpose symmetry B_{H,W}=B_{W,H}. columns: H W n count
